title: Live
subtitle: 「生活／生存／過活」，是一個高度多義動詞。這個單元集中處理你提供的方向：在有限資源或困難情況下『活下去／應付生活／勉強過活』，而不是 live in Hong Kong 這類單純居
description: 「生活／生存／過活」，是一個高度多義動詞。這個單元集中處理你提供的方向：在有限資源或困難情況下『活下去／應付生活／勉強過活』，而不是 live in Hong Kong 這類單純居住義。

words.example: The family survived the winter with very little money.
words.exampleZh: 這個家庭靠很少的錢捱過了冬天。

exercises.original: The family lived through the winter with very little money.
exercises.zh: 這個家庭靠很少的錢捱過了冬天。
exercises.upgrade: The family survived the winter with very little money.

options.explanation: winter + very little money indicates hardship overcome, so survive is precise。
resided/stayed concern location。
earned concerns income generation, not living through hardship。
managed comfortably contradicts the difficulty。
existed abstractly is too detached from the hardship context.
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。

exercises.original: Only a few plants can live in such dry conditions.
exercises.zh: 只有少數植物能在如此乾旱的環境中生存。
exercises.upgrade: Only a few plants can survive in such dry conditions.

options.explanation: harsh environmental conditions determine whether plants remain alive, fitting survive。
reside/stay are location verbs for people/animals in another sense。
get by financially/manage a budget are human coping contexts。
earn is irrelevant.
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。

exercises.original: The business may not live through another year of losses.

options.explanation: continued existence despite financial losses is survive。
reside/stay/live at are location-focused。

本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。

words.example: They manage on a very small monthly income.

options.explanation: small income + coping successfully fits manage on。

exercises.original: We can live with the current budget if we're careful.

options.explanation: budget + careful spending is a classic manage on context。
reside/stay are location-based。
exist on is unnatural here。
earn on does not mean cope with a budget。
survive at is not the right structure.
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。

words.example: She gets by on a modest pension.

falseSynonyms.zh: 留下／逗留不等於 live stay 強調暫時停留；live 通常是居住、生活或生存。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Stay is usually temporary.

falseSynonyms.zh: 居住不等於 survive/manage reside 只在『居住於某處』sense 接近 live。
exist 只在『存在』sense 接近 live exist 不等於過日子、維生或居住。
survive 只在『面對困難仍活下來』sense 接近 live survive 帶威脅／困難意味。
manage 只在『應付得到』sense 接近 live manage 不表示生命存在或居住地。
get by 只在『勉強過活』sense 接近 live get by 帶資源有限或能力剛好足夠的意味。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Get by implies adequacy under limits.

falseSynonyms.zh: 賺錢不等於 live earn 只是取得收入；是否足夠維生是另一回事。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Earning money is not the same as living on it.

falseSynonyms.zh: 詞性陷阱 live 可作動詞；alive 是形容詞，通常不放在名詞前作一般修飾。
